DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD.title: Death's Head
DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD.description: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
DD2MODCONFIG-STRESS_COUNTER_RELIC.title: Stress Counter
DD2MODCONFIG-STRESS_COUNTER_RELIC.descri: Record your current [gold]Stress[/gold]. At the end of combat, retain your [gold]Stress[/gold].
DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD_DAMAGE.title: Death's Head
DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD_DAMAGE.descript: If your HP is [green]{LowHealthPercent}%[/green] or less, deal [blue]{AdditionalDamagePercent}%[/blue] additional attack damage.
DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD_BLOCK.title: Death's Head
DD2MODCONFIG-DEATHS_HEAD_BLOCK.descripti: If your HP is [green]{LowHealthPercent}%[/green] or less, at the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
